goal: Pick up all four bottles from the table and throw/put them into the dustbin standing beside the table (use a handover between the two hands when a bottle is out of reach), then return the arms to their start pose.
instruction_templates: Pick up the bottles and throw them into the dustbin, using handover when needed.
success: For each bottle k in bottle0..bottle3 simultaneously: the dustbin's footprint (convex hull of its rotated bbox in XY) contains the bottle's whole footprint (convex hull of its rotated bbox corners in XY); the bottle's bbox top z is below the dustbin's bbox top z; and the bottle's bbox bottom z minus the dustbin's bbox bottom z is within [0.0, 0.4] m (this also implies bottle bottom > dustbin bottom - 0.03 m).

Both target arms are back at origin: all target arms (left_arm and right_arm; the support arm is not counted) have their end-effector pose within 0.15 m on EACH axis (|dx|,|dy|,|dz| all <= 0.15 m) and within 20 degrees (quaternion angle) of the pose they had at the start of the episode (recorded after the scene settled).
evaluation: Single stage; all 4 bottle conditions and the arms-home condition must hold simultaneously after one action. The reward manager is evaluated only once per action (after the sim sub-steps of that action are finished), never between sub-steps. In each evaluation the FIRST pending stage of the check list is tested (every condition in it, all at that same moment; a condition that is a nested list is an OR); when it passes it is removed permanently (never re-verified later) and the next stage becomes pending; at most one stage is removed per action. Reward is 1.0 only when the check list is empty (and no query/trigger counter is violated); the episode is declared a success as soon as reward >= 0.999 after an action, and ends as a failure if the action counter reaches step_lim without that, or earlier if the environment is flagged failed (query counter exceeded, see below). No final_check list is registered by this task, so the final-check logic at step_lim adds nothing. No early failure.
objects: bottle0..bottle3: four different bottles (Rigid, 'bottle' category, 4 distinct models drawn from indices 0,2,5,22,25,41,50,55,59,60), table-frame x in [-0.35,0.45], y in [-0.25,0.02], random yaw; bottles with x<0.05 have yaw range [-90,30] deg, x>=0.05 have [-30,90] deg; margin 0.02; may be standing or lying
dustbin: dustbin (Geometry, static, 1), fixed at ground-frame x=-0.63, y=-0.1, z=0.35 (to the side of the table, raised), identity orientation
end_requirements: Both arms within 0.15 m per axis and 20 deg of their start pose at the same action in which all four bottles are inside the dustbin.
notes: The dustbin is only reachable by one arm, bottles on the right side of the table need a handover between the hands (per the task description in the wiki; not enforced by code). The in-bin test is a bounding-box test of the bottle's entire bbox in the dustbin's footprint hull and below the bin's top, so a bottle leaning on the rim or sticking out above the rim fails; a bottle that falls out later invalidates the stage because all four are tested together on the same action. The upper z bound of 0.4 m relative to the dustbin bottom is rarely binding. Partial score (get_score only): 10/25/40/100 for 1/2/3/4 bottles with open grippers (>=0.8) / home.
